corrected_fields.summary: Commerce Bancshares filed an 8-K on April 21, 2026, disclosing Q1 2026 earnings results via referenced exhibits (press release and slide deck) without including actual financial figures in the filing body. The filing is furnished under Item 2.02 (Results of Operations) and explicitly states the information is not 'filed' for regulatory purposes.
corrected_fields.why_it_matters: Outside scope of market structure or macro catalysts. This is a routine regional bank earnings disclosure with no substantive financial data in the filing body—actual figures exist only in referenced exhibits (99.1 and 99.2) not included in the source text. No systemic relevance to financial markets or policy.
